review.dependencyDirection: No project references or provider/product dependencies added. Core owns request/admission/orchestration, Modules.AgentFramework composes the existing current-profile and concrete workspace services.
review.partialClasses: No partial file added. Existing facades route to the cohesive inherited owner; startup record moved out of the execution monolith. Existing provider preparation, credentials, activity, completion and failure persistence are reused through typed delegates.
review.findings: Two new informational DTO-size findings: the moved 9-member startup value and the 10-member inherited in-process request. No new cycles. The one net added DI diagnostic is the narrow interface alias factory, verified by actual workspace composition tests. Existing file/type size findings remain.
review.runtimeBoundary: The held lease covers the entire completion lifecycle. Retained exact reads bypass its dispatch lease; creation repeats its lookup under that lease. Product source authorization and manager/publication activation remain closed.
